entries.title: The Cost of Disease
entries.description: The Yellow Fever had struck the village, and for several weeks any visit to its somber limits forced the young heirs to keep a cloth handkerchief about their mouth and nostrils to protect from the miasma. While they were remiss to admit it, this seemed the perfect macabre backdrop in which to advance their father's dreadful business.

entries.title: Fear of the Unknown
entries.description: It is with great reticence that I relay a grievous event which occurred upon my arrival. Upon entering that dismal village to settle my deceased father's affairs, a commotion drew my attention -- and revealed a horror I would spend the rest of my time there trying to understand.

entries.title: A Time of War
entries.description: My father was a genius! I state this now not with the naivete of my initial discovery of his journal, but as a time-tested statement of truth. Weary as I was from the excursion across the Hungarian plains, nothing could have prepared me for the secret laboratory hidden beneath the manor -- or what it would ask of our family in the years to come.

entries.title: My Father's Work — Common Assets
entries.description: Shared style, fonts, icons, images, and audio used across the official My Father's Work scenarios, plus the layout chrome for the popup/passage types they all share (choice, note, prompt, ranking, score panels, and more).
